en: A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a hilltop castle complex rising above a town with pitched-roof houses and trees in the foreground. The large Gothic and Renaissance-style building complex is prominently featured on the ridge, with towers and spires visible. The lower margin has printed red script text identifying the site and city, and there is a small vertical printer's credit on the left side.
